criteria.criterion: Original behaviour 1–5: server-pinned period/settings/cutoff; no implicit writes; settings-drift guard; immutable first-writer-wins recovery; browser expectations are limited and rollover-safe.
evidence: hardening verification: focused tests and live Postgres contention fixture
criteria.note: The service derives the prior month from server settings, captures one cutoff, returns existing coordinates before building, validates recovery expectations and recovers the stored winner after a concurrent insert.

criteria.criterion: Original behaviour 6: project-isolated, bounded, deterministic source selection with cap-plus-one overflow and bounded safe URL facts.
evidence: hardening verification: focused D1 tests and live Postgres fixture
criteria.note: Provider-aware final ID collation, caps, project predicates, URL batching and overflow inputs are implemented and exercised.

criteria.criterion: Original behaviour 7–12: completed work, Performance, earlier-work Results, meaningful Changes, Risks, Next month and Opportunities follow the required source policies, ordering, caps and disjointness.
criteria.note: Focused evidence covers status/date predicates, cutoff and due-date boundaries, independent Result caps, Change link cardinality, queue disjointness and ties.

criteria.criterion: Original behaviour 13–14: deterministic eight-section frozen summaries and no persistence for change-only or unsupported activity.
criteria.note: The builder emits canonical sections in order and the service returns no_activity without creating a Report when eligible Action or terminal Result evidence is absent.

criteria.criterion: Original behaviour 15–16: every display field is safely projected and the client DTO is a strict privacy allowlist.
criteria.note: Tests cover credentials, raw and encoded emails, userinfo, query/fragment stripping, non-display identifiers and DTO exclusion.

criteria.criterion: Original behaviour 17–18 and product UX: Monthly summary is first after the Growth header, is read-only until Build, has accessible loading/error/retry/recovery states, and renders one semantic frozen Report article with all sections.

criteria.criterion: Original behaviour 19: an uncertain request across a local-month or timezone rollover only recovers the echoed existing winner; otherwise it reads current state and does not write.
criteria.note: Recovery expectation distance, old-coordinate lookup and stale-expectation current-read paths are present and tested.

evidence: hardening verification: live Postgres monthly repository, settings-lock and coordinator-contention fixture
